data.one_liner: Flutter widget that displays particle effects similar to particles.js.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a ready‑to‑use widget that renders animated particles on the screen. It works on all major Flutter platforms and requires only a single widget in the UI tree.
use_when: you need a simple particle background or visual effect
you want a quick, cross‑platform solution without native code
avoid_when: performance is critical for large particle counts
you need highly custom or physics‑driven animations
strengths: easy to add with a single widget
works on mobile, web, and desktop out of the box
no native setup or permissions required
weaknesses: potential performance impact on low‑end devices
